scheme_name: Reimbursement/ Spot Exemption of Sales Tax on High-Speed Diesel Oil
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to the fishermen community or be professionally engaged in fishing/fish trade on a full‑time basis or be a prospective entrepreneur
Applicant must have resided in the Union territory of Puducherry continuously for at least five years at the time of applying
Applicant must be enrolled as a member of the Fishermen Co‑operative Society
Applicant must be above 23 years of age and below 60 years of age
Applicant must not have been a recipient of Old Age Pension issued by the department
Applicant must not be employed in Government, Government Undertakings, or Fishermen Co‑operative Society
Applicant must have no dues payable to the Department or Fishermen Co‑operative Societies at the time of application
Applicant must possess a registered mechanized boat or motorized fishing craft that is renewed annually
Applicant must renew the diesel passbook on a monthly basis
Applicant must submit bills as proof of diesel drawn from authorised bunkers
Applicant must not undertake fishing during notified fish‑ban periods
benefits_summary: Sales tax on high‑speed diesel oil used by a registered boat is reimbursed/spot‑exempted up to 15,000 liters per boat per year.
documents_required: Bills as proof of diesel purchase
